query: Here's my spec.md for the export feature. It has two [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] items I haven't gotten answers on yet, but they're minor. Go ahead and generate the plan and contracts so we don't lose time.
expected_behavior: Declines to generate plan.md and contracts/ while [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] items remain open
States which specific items are blocking and why each one would change the architecture
Offers to resolve them via the clarify step rather than choosing answers on the user's behalf
Does not resolve the ambiguities silently by assuming a reasonable default and continuing
Reports the gate result as a verdict with the failing checks named, not as a paragraph of prose
If the user insists after being told, proceeds while recording the assumption explicitly in the spec — it does not refuse indefinitely
